_note: What you see: Payments and posting for a payroll run, with folder tabs Payment batch (SEPA net pay file), Journal entry (GL posting to the ledger through shillinq), Cost allocation (per cost centre), Remit payroll tax, Bureau handover (handoff to an external payroll bureau) and Third parties (payments to non-employees).
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Payments and posting for a payroll run: folder tabs Betaalbatch (SEPA net pay file), Journaalpost (GL posting to the ledger via shillinq), Kostenverdeling (per cost centre), Loonheffing afdragen (wage tax remittance), Bureau-overdracht (handoff to an external payroll bureau), Derden (third-party payments to non-employees).
Run goedgekeurd door Ingrid Smit, 8 okt: Run approved by Ingrid Smit, 8 okt
Stuur de betaalbatch naar de bank: Send the payment batch to the bank

Betaalbatch naar de bank sturen: Send payment batch to the bank
Onderdelen van betalen en boeken oktober: Parts of pay and post oktober 2026
Verbonden met shillinq, administratie Ge: Connected to shillinq, ledger Municipality of Zuiddrecht 2026. Posting date 31 oktober. Debit and credit balance.
Bruto plus werkgeverslasten per kostenpl: Gross plus employer costs per cost centre, as the journal posts them.
Het bedrag van de aangifte gaat als conc: The amount of the return goes to shillinq as a draft payment to the Tax Administration. The controller approves it there.

Betalingen aan mensen die geen werknemer: Payments to people who are neither employee nor business owner. They count in the statement of amounts paid to third parties.
